FedDES_Eq2.fixed_query_top_k: argtopk_m G_m(i)=argtopk_m A_m(i), with the same ties; the weighted-log-loss tie breaker is separate
FedDES_Eq2.softmax_extension_if_used: softmax_m(G_m/t)=softmax_m(A_m/t) for fixed positive t; this extension is algebra, not a FedDES implementation claim
FedDES_Eq2.normalization_limit: All-equal A_m makes all gains zero; dividing gains by their selected sum needs a stated convention. Negative selected gains are also possible. No author-code convention was read.

query_attention.capacity: Already query-dependent: in a one-dimensional witness, q=+1/-1 and keys+1/-1 reverse neighbor ranking. This is a function-class observation, not measured behavior.

empty_label_support.zero_context: No permitted label values ->g_m=0 ->gamma(H_i)⊙g_m=0 ->bias-free logits=0; explicit native fallback then stays native.
empty_label_support.affected_operator: Current label-only family including receiver FiLM gate; no claim about arbitrary GNN/feature-valued routes
empty_label_support.utility_inference: This exposes a support boundary; it proves no feature-message benefit.
